def factor_price_volume_dollar_coherence_stability(df):
    """Price-dollar-volume rank coherence modulated by dollar-volume trend stability."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    window = 20
    dollar_volume = close * volume

    close_rank = close.rolling(window, min_periods=window).rank(pct=True)
    dollar_volume_rank = dollar_volume.rolling(window, min_periods=window).rank(pct=True)
    pv_corr = close_rank.rolling(window, min_periods=window).corr(dollar_volume_rank)

    # Lightweight idea from parent2: volume trend stability bounded multiplier
    dollar_volume_slope = pd.Series(talib.LINEARREG_SLOPE(dollar_volume.values.astype(float), timeperiod=window), index=df_copy.index)
    dollar_volume_std = dollar_volume.rolling(window, min_periods=window).std(ddof=1)
    dollar_volume_stability = dollar_volume_slope / dollar_volume_std.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    stability_modifier = 1.0 + 0.25 * np.tanh(dollar_volume_stability)

    factor = pv_corr * stability_modifier
    df_copy["factor_price_volume_dollar_coherence_stability"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_price_volume_dollar_coherence_stability"]
